title: Mayor Earl Cabell, brother Charles Cabell of CIA, motorcade route

tellings.quote: Um the mayor of Dallas was a guy named Earl Cabel. Yeah. And um his his brother Charles was Dallas's number two at the CIA on the Bay of Pigs.

plain: Michels points out that the mayor of Dallas when President Kennedy was shot, a man named Earl Cabell, had a brother, Charles Cabell, who he says was number two at the CIA at the time of the Bay of Pigs invasion. Michels raises it himself, without a source, on an episode linking Kennedy to UFO secrets, suggesting a family tie between the CIA and the city that set the motorcade route.
